summary: Backend-only testing completed for /api/generate-daily-report fallback hardening. All 26 tests passed (18 existing + 8 new fallback behavior tests). The fallback logic correctly handles: (1) missing previous_bank_amount with no prior data returns 400, (2) auto-fetches from yesterday's report, (3) walks back to Day-2 when Day-1 is missing, (4) auto-fetches previous_stock_value, (5) backward compatibility with explicit values, (6) HTTPException(400) not masked as 500, (7) financial-data-range works after fallback flow, (8) liquor_sales defaults to 0.0.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically via MongoDB fixtures with unique dates (2019, 2025-06 to 2025-11) and cleaned up after each test class
context_for_next_testing_agent: All fallback behavior tests for /api/generate-daily-report are passing. The endpoint now correctly: (a) makes previous_bank_amount Optional[float]=None, (b) defaults liquor_sales to 0.0, (c) queries last financial_data before target date and uses its current_bank_amount/current_stock_value as fallback, (d) raises HTTPException(400) with clear message when no prior record exists, (e) re-raises HTTPException before generic Exception handler. Test file test_generate_daily_report_fallback.py covers all 7 specified test cases plus liquor_sales default behavior.

TestFallbackStockValue.test_auto_fetch_stock_value: PASSED - Auto-fetches previous_stock_value from prior record's current_stock_value (420000)

TestBackwardCompatibility.test_explicit_value_not_overridden: PASSED - User-provided values (300000, 600000) used instead of fallback values (255000, 520000)

TestHTTPExceptionNotMasked.test_400_not_masked_as_500: PASSED - HTTPException(400) correctly propagated, not masked as 500

TestFinancialDataRangeAfterFallback.test_financial_data_range_after_fallback: PASSED - Returns all 3 records correctly after fallback flow, Day 2 has previous_bank_amount=155000 from Day 1 fallback

TestLiquorSalesDefaultsToZero.test_liquor_sales_defaults_to_zero: PASSED - liquor_sales correctly defaults to 0.0 when not provided
